gamma_condition.label: Near Gamma Flip
gamma_condition.explanation: Balanced: weighted call share is 52.0% across absolute GEX (50%), OI (25%), and volume (25%). Positive Gamma. Spot is 0.09% from the gamma flip.
gamma_condition.methodology: Call dominance = 50% absolute-GEX share + 25% OI share + 25% volume share. >=60% is call dominated, <=40% put dominated. Near flip means spot is within 0.50% of the nearest repriced gamma-profile crossing.

freshness.note: Open interest is a previous-session observation. Signed exposures and key levels are model-derived from the selected normalized contracts.

methodology.gex: Gamma × OI × multiplier × spot² × 0.01, signed by configured convention.
methodology.dex: Assumed dealer DEX = raw contract DEX × configured call/put position sign. Raw DEX = signed option delta × OI × multiplier × spot; both are returned separately.
methodology.net_oi: Call open interest minus put open interest; both legs are also reported.
methodology.aggregation: Exposure is calculated per contract first, then summed by strike.
